limitations: Headless Windows and disposable synthetic English only; no broad accuracy, multilingual, mobile, or long-session claim.
Timer gaps and control round-trip time measure this machine only.
Readiness kept a loaded worker/model in memory; cold offline browser restart and cache eviction were not tested.

An initial test harness asserted on a missing pre-start transcript node, and another included the deliberately blocked external probe in an origin-only check. Both harness errors were corrected; the reported fresh-profile Chrome and Edge runs completed all assertions.
